latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of ratio stimulation visual wood, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.

research_needs.question: Does the effect of ratio stimulation visual wood on pulse rate replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is low. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.
